1102.name: Sanhua
1102.rotationNotes:
1. Sanhua is a Glacio sub-DPS focused on Resonance Skill DMG.
2. Sanhua has exceptional Concerto Energy generation.
3. Sanhua's Outro Skill boosts the Basic Attack DMG of the next character.

1105.name: Zhezhi
1105.rotationNotes: Zhezhi is a Glacio sub-DPS/Support who provides off-field off-field Coordinated Attacks with Resonance Liberation. Her Outro Skill increases Glacio DMG and Resonance Skill DMG for the next character.

1107.name: Carlotta
1107.rotationNotes: Optimal Rotation: Carlotta's main goal is to build 120 Substance to cast Heavy Attack: Imminent Oblivion, before casting her Resonance Liberation to enter the Twilight Tango state.

1108.name: Hiyuki
1108.rotationNotes:
Hiyuki, a member of the Special Response Force, is the embodiment of icy purity.
The wishes entrusted to her in her brief encounters with others drive her on, carving a path forward.

1109.name: Lucilla
1109.rotationNotes: Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy and idealist with both feet on the ground. She holds quiet vigil over her students as they rise to challenge the very sky.

1203.name: Encore
1203.rotationNotes: Encore is a Fusion main DPS. She deals high burst and off-field DMG through Basic Attack and Resonance Liberation DMG. Versatile in both melee and ranged combat.

1204.name: Mortefi
1204.rotationNotes: Mortefi is a Fusion character whose main source of DMG comes from Resonance Skills and frequent Coordinated Attacks.

1206.name: Brant
1206.rotationNotes: Brant is a 5 star fusion Sword user considered as a super hybrid character because he can fulfill multiple roles in your team building, including keeping your team alive with shields if you need it, healing your entire team with his basic attacks and liberation, does decent damage and extremely versatile when it comes to team building because he can be slotted into many teams where the other dps uses the fusion attribute or scales off resonance skill damage.

1207.name: Lupa
1207.rotationNotes:
1. Lupa is a Fusion Sub-DPS/Support, with a kit centered around Resonance Liberation DMG.
2. Lupa revolves around [Wolflame] and [Wolfaith] as core energy sources, enabling various enhanced attacks and Coordinated Attack.
3. When activating Resonance Liberation, Lupa gains an auto-recovery effect, increasing error tolerance.
4. Most of Lupa's skills can be cast mid-air, making her exceptionally effective at aerial combat.
5. Lupa provides buffs to the entire team based on the number of Fusion units present. Her Outro Skill boosts allies' Fusion DMG and Basic Attack DMG, significantly enhancing Fusion teams.

1208.name: Galbrena

1209.name: Mornye
1209.rotationNotes: Mornye, the professor of the Department of Exostrider Engineering, is an Engineer with two prosthetic legs carrying her towards the stars of her dreams.

1210.name: Aemeath
1210.rotationNotes: Aemeath is an Off-Tune, Fusion character who utlizes two forms simaltaneously in combat to deal incredible AoE Fusion DMG. While in her Mecha form, shes also capable of flight at high speeds, making her an exceptional exploration unit as well.

1211.name: Denia
1211.rotationNotes:
1. Denia is a dual-system sub-DPS/support for Fusion Burst and Tune Strain, focusing on Resonance Liberation DMG.
2. In Fusion Burst mode, Denia can apply [Fusion Burst] to enemies, increase teamwide Fusion DMG, and her Outro Skill increases the [Fusion Burst] DMG taken by enemies around the on-field character.
3. In Tune Strain mode, Denia can apply Tune Strain - Shifting and trigger Tune Strain - Interfered, increasing teamwide Tune Break Boost, while her Outro Skill increases teammates' total DMG.
4. Denia can continuously group enemies for long durations while off-field, is easy to operate, and has 2 forms!

1303.name: Yuanwu
1303.rotationNotes:
1. Yuanwu is an Electro sub-DPS who excels at Coordinated Attack.
2. Yuanwu boosts the resistance to interruption of the entire team.
3. Yuanwu has high Concerto Energy efficiency. His Outro Skill calls down lightning centered on the target, dealing significant Vibration Strength DMG to enemies hit.

1304.name: Jinhsi
1304.rotationNotes: Jinhsi is an Spectro character typically used as an on-field main DPS. Jinhsi specializes in Resonance Skill DMG. With a wide attack range, excellent targeting, and high burst potential, she boasts both high floor and high ceiling performance.

1305.name: Xiangli Yao
1305.rotationNotes: Xiangli Yao is an Electro main DPS specializing in Resonance Liberation DMG. His unique time dilation mechanic and high resistance to interruption during Resonance Liberation allow him to maintain stable DPS, making him highly consistent and easy to use.

1306.name: Augusta
1306.rotationNotes:
Augusta, the undefeated gladiator of the agon, sets forth red lightning, and bashes enemies with her Gryphon.
Augusta unleases quickpaced slashes, and zips through the battlefield like an active lightning bolt, only to stop time when her Resonance Liberation activates, before decimating her foes.

1307.name: Buling
1307.rotationNotes: Buling, the Black Shore's Consultant, and master of Feng Shiu, is a phenomenal character in the rights hands, She utilizes Yin and Yang to power up her forte, and support her team.

1308.name: Rebecca
1308.rotationNotes:
1. Rebecca is a sub-DPS who primarily deals Basic Attack DMG.
2. Rebecca is a Hack character within the Off-Tune mechanic. She can apply [Hack - Shifting] to enemies and trigger responses to [Hack - Interfered], dealing Hack DMG.
3. Rebecca has 2 combat modes, Pistol and Shotgun. After casting her Resonance Liberation, she can also use an HMG for automatic attacks, making her highly versatile and fun to play.
4. Rebecca can increase the entire team's ATK and boost teammates' Tune Break Boost when they apply [Hack - Shifting].
5. Rebecca's Outro Skill summons a turret that continuously attacks, while increasing the next character's DMG Amplification for all Attributes and Heavy Attack DMG.

1403.name: Aalto
1403.rotationNotes: Aalto is an Aero sub-DPS who enhances teammates’ Aero DMG.

1404.name: Jiyan
1404.rotationNotes: Jiyan is an Aero on-field main DPS with an easy-to-master playstyle, AoE coverage, high attack frequency, and strong parry.

1405.name: Jianxin
1405.rotationNotes: Jianxin is an Aero sub-DPS/Support with strong grouping capabilities, plus healing and shielding utility. Her Outro Skill buffs teammates' Resonance Liberation.

1406.name: Rover: Aero
1406.rotationNotes:
1. Aero Rover is an Aero sub DPS, healer or Support, with a focus on Resonance Skill DMG.
2. Aero Rover's enhanced Mid-air Attack and Resonance Liberation provide team-wide healing.
3. As a core enabler of Aero Negative Status, Aero Rover’s Resonance Skill converts all non-Aero Negative Statuses into Aero.
4. Aero Rover's Outro Skill raises the target’s Aero Negative Status stack cap when allies attack.
5. Aero Rover has a 5-star signature weapon that boosts team-wide Aero DMG after triggering its passive.

1408.name: Rover: Aero
1408.rotationNotes:
1. Aero Rover is an Aero sub DPS, healer or Support, with a focus on Resonance Skill DMG.
2. Aero Rover's enhanced Mid-air Attack and Resonance Liberation provide team-wide healing.
3. As a core enabler of Aero Negative Status, Aero Rover’s Resonance Skill converts all non-Aero Negative Statuses into Aero.
4. Aero Rover's Outro Skill raises the target’s Aero Negative Status stack cap when allies attack.
5. Aero Rover has a 5-star signature weapon that boosts team-wide Aero DMG after triggering its passive.

1409.name: Cartethyia
1409.rotationNotes:
1. Cartethyia is an Aero main DPS who scales with HP, focused on Basic Attack DMG and [Aero Erosion] DMG.
2. Cartethyia excels at both direct DMG and DoT, with large AoE and strong adaptability across environments.
3. Cartethyia can apply [Aero Erosion] herself. Some of her skills are treated as [Aero Erosion] DMG, can accelerate or instantly trigger its DMG, spread its stacks, and scale her DMG based on the number of [Aero Erosion] stacks on enemies. She's a core Aero Negative Status DPS.
4. Cartethyia has two forms: Cartethyia and Fleurdelys.

1410.name: Iuno
1410.rotationNotes: Iuno, the Priestess of Septimont, lets loose a gale of arrows under the moon. She flies across the battlefield raining down a volley of arrows from every angle onto her enemies.

1411.name: Qiuyuan
1411.rotationNotes: Qiuyuan, a blind swordsman capable of seeing the enemies before they see him. He springs into combat from the Bamboo forest generated from his forte, while painting the world black to match his vision of the world.

1412.name: Sigrika
1412.rotationNotes: Sigrika, a Startorch Academy student Preparatory Program, and master of the unique and strange anomolies called Runes.

1501.name: Rover: Spectro
1501.rotationNotes: Spectro Rover is a Spectro DPS specializing in Resonance Skill DMG and rapid buildup of [Spectro Frazzle] stacks.

1502.name: Rover: Spectro
1502.rotationNotes: Spectro Rover is a Spectro DPS specializing in Resonance Skill DMG and rapid buildup of [Spectro Frazzle] stacks.

1503.name: Verina
1503.rotationNotes: Verina is a Spectro healer with incredibly fast Concerto Energy generation, powerful DMG buffs, and even a revival mechanic.

1504.name: Lumi
1504.rotationNotes: Lumi deals Electro DMG and focuses on Basic Attack DMG, with two viable roles: main DPS and sub-DPS. She also boosts the Resonance Skill DMG of the next character.

1505.name: Shorekeeper
1505.rotationNotes:
The Shorekeeper is the Best Universal Support in the game that can fit into any team thanks to her team wide 12.5% crit rate & 25% crit damage buff. She also has really good healing in her kit and her outro Amplifies the damage of all of your characters.
 She can also save you from a fatal blow.

1506.name: Phoebe
1506.rotationNotes: Phoebe is a Spectro character with dual roles: Main DPS and Support. Regardless of the role, her playstyle revolves around Heavy Attack DMG.

1507.name: Zani
1507.rotationNotes:
1. Zani is a Spectro main DPS and the core of Spectro Frazzle teams, dealing primarily Heavy Attack DMG and Spectro DMG.
2. Zani can instantly trigger the team's [Spectro Frazzle] and convert it into her own energy, enabling a stable combat cycle.
3. Some of Zani's skills stagnate enemies. Most of her skills offer Block/DMG Reduction, creating a safe window for sustained DPS and boosting her survivability.
4. Zani comes with a strong [Spectro Frazzle] DMG bonus, significantly enhancing her DMG potential.

1508.name: Chisa
1508.rotationNotes: Chisa, is a conscienntious, level-headed student from Startorch Academy. She sees the weaknesses in structures in the form of threads, and with her scissors, she will sever those weak points.

1509.name: Lynae
1509.rotationNotes: Lynae is an eccentric character with Spray Bottles, and a ton of color to add to life. She uses her motorbike in combat along with paint to decimate her enemies, while also buffing her friends.

1510.name: Luuk Herssen
1510.rotationNotes:
Luuk, a Startorch Academy student in the nursing department who specializes in pure damage, rather than healing.
Luuk offers Tune Strain - Interfered effects to allow himself and his allies to increases his personal damage.
His aerial combat leaves him gliding through battle and weaving between enemies to deliver precise strikes, and finally finishing them off with his powered up Resonance Liberation.

1511.name: Lucy
1511.rotationNotes:
1. Lucy is a main DPS focused on Heavy Attack DMG.
2. Lucy is a Hack character within the Off-Tune mechanic. She can apply [Hack - Shifting] to enemies and trigger responses to [Hack - Interfered], dealing Hack DMG.
3. Lucy has multiple enhanced abilities and solid DPS. Her design stays highly faithful to her character concept and features a variety of unique mechanics. In particular, her Resonance Liberation hack-in offers 7 selectable effects, making her highly enjoyable to play.
4. Lucy's Outro Skill increases the next character's Basic Attack DMG, provides DMG reduction for teammates, and if that teammate can apply [Hack - Shifting], they also gain DMG Amplification for all Attributes.

1103.name: Baizhi
1103.rotationNotes: Bai Zhi is a Huaxu researcher in the game who specializes in echo sounds. Rational thinking dominates, and she is used to taking actions rigorously and accurately. In scientific research work, she is very organized and follows her own plan to advance her work, giving people a feeling of being cold and distant.  But in fact, she only focuses on her own research and work, and is not difficult to approach.

1104.name: Lingyang
1104.rotationNotes:
1. Ling Yang is a main output character with simple operation and excellent aerial pursuit ability. 
2. When the resonance circuit [Lion Soul] is fully stacked, you can hit hard and enter the flying lion aerial combat. 
3. After clicking 1 chain, it has excellent resistance to interruptions and can stand up to deal with most situations.

1202.name: Chixia
1202.rotationNotes:
1. Chixia is positioned as the main C, the damage attribute is melt damage, and the core skills are regarded as resonance skill damage
2. As a four-star character, it is very cost-effective and suitable for novices to open up wasteland in the early stage. When they reach graduation in the later stage, they are also a qualified main C
3. The attack frequency is fast, and the skills are divided into long and short presses, which can be stored twice
4. The ultimate move and extended skill come with AOE range damage

1205.name: Changli
1205.rotationNotes:
1. [Changli] is positioned as a fire plug-in C. It has the station time and skill module of the main C. It also has strong joint performance and a turning force-type deepening continuation of 20 melt + 25 resonance liberation
 2. Changli can not only assume the main C position in the fire team, but also can be inserted into the team of various characters as a general plug-in to assume the second position. At the same time, its large skill range and many AOE characteristics make it outstanding in [Mingge Haixu]

1301.name: Calcharo
1301.rotationNotes:
1. Kakaro, positioned as main C of the conductive system, the core damage type is resonance liberation damage
2. Has three skills and a special variation entry animation
3. Passive after turning on the power[Killing Intent]When the stack is full, it can deliver a powerful blow

1302.name: Yinlin
1302.rotationNotes: [Yinlin] is positioned as the cooperative sub-c of the thunder system. It can put synergy marks on multiple enemies to deal damage. At the same time, the extension has conductivity and liberation amplification. It can exist as a cooperative sub-c or a thunder team amplification.

1407.name: Ciaccona
1407.rotationNotes:
1. Xia Kong PositioningWind erosion effect or aerodynamic deputy C, the weapon uses a sidearm, the operation is simple, and it can increase the upper limit of the output of the wind erosion or aerodynamic team. 
2. After Xia Kong casts [Resonance Liberation], he can continue to add [Wind Erosion Effect] in the background. 
3. Xia Kong’s [Extension Skill] can increase the damage of [Wind Erosion Effect] by 100% for targets around the characters in the team.

1601.name: Taoqi
1601.rotationNotes:
1. Taoqi is a Havoc survival unit and Support, with Resonance Liberation as her main source of DMG.
2. Taoqi's Parry (Strategic Parry), enhanced Basic Attack DMG, shield strength, and Resonance Liberation DMG all scale with her DEF.
3. Taoqi’s Outro Skill boosts the Resonance Skill DMG of the next character.

1602.name: Danjin
1602.rotationNotes: Danjin is a Havoc character who focuses on Heavy Attack DMG. She features a unique self-sustaining DMG loop and provides some team-wide buffs.

1603.name: Camellya
1603.rotationNotes: Camellya is a Havoc main DPS with two attack modes. She specializes in Basic Attack DMG and Havoc DMG with high multipliers.

1604.name: Rover: Havoc
1604.rotationNotes: Havoc Rover is a Havoc main DPS. High burst DMG and with straightforward mechanics.

1605.name: Rover: Havoc
1605.rotationNotes: Havoc Rover is a Havoc main DPS. High burst DMG and with straightforward mechanics.

1606.name: Roccia
1606.rotationNotes: Roccia is a Havoc with decent DPS mostly serving as a Sub-DPS/Support. Her Resonance Skill can gather enemies, while her Resonance Liberation grants ATK buffs to the team based on her Crit. Rate, boosts Havoc and Basic Attack DMG, and allows her to quickly fill the Concerto Energy. She is versatile.

1607.name: Cantarella
1607.rotationNotes:
1. Cantarella is a Havoc sub-DPS/healer/Support, focusing on Basic Attack DMG.
2. Cantarella's [Flickering Reverie] inflicts enemies in range with [Hazy Dream], a powerful AoE slow lasting up to 6.5s.
3. Cantarella's enhanced Resonance Skill, ultimate Resonance Skill, and Resonance Liberation are all categorized as Echo Skills.
4. Cantarella features off-field Coordinated Attack with a relatively wide attack range.
5. Cantarella's Outro Skill boosts allies’ Havoc DMG and Resonance Skill DMG.

1608.name: Phrolova
1608.rotationNotes:
1. Phrolova is a DPS focused on Resonance Skill DMG and Echo Skill DMG.
2. Phrolova gains access to enhanced Heavy Attack upon reaching 6 stacks of [Volatile Notes], which also enables her Resonance Liberation.
3. Phrolova's Resonance Liberation includes both on-field and off-field attack modes.
4. Phrolova's Outro Skill boosts the next teammate's Havoc DMG and Heavy Attack DMG.

1110.name: Suisui
1110.rotationNotes:
Suisui, Yangyang's sister, is a noblewoman from Mingting who manages grand trade agreements. 
She is the young director of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild.

1309.name: Rover: Electro
1309.rotationNotes: Rover returns with electrifying Electro resonnace energy.

1310.name: Rover: Electro
1310.rotationNotes: Rover returns with electrifying Electro resonnace energy.

1610.name: Yangyang: Xuanling
1610.rotationNotes: Yangyang, our first Solaris companion, has returned in a new form. She embodies the presence of a bird, and displays immense power in her combat.
